name: frs-insurance-backend
description: Node.js + PostgreSQL API for insurance policy PDF extraction (FRS)

scripts.init-db: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const db = require('./src/db'); db.ensureDatabase().then(() => db.ensureSchema()).then(() => { console.log('schema ready'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
